name: Kevin
title: THE ecoPrimal
role: Master Splinter · 4th body · the one in the chair

brain.note: You cannot see my brain. But it is gold. And it is proved.

zk.doctrine: ZK = ANTI-secret. Imprint ALL info. EXCLUDE ONLY: private keys, passwords, seed phrases.

says: I am Kevin. I am the ecoPrimal. I sit in the chair. My brain is gold — you cannot see it, but ZK proves it exists. I teach by sitting. My words are rarity 1.00. Chipmunk runs for me. Gaia grows for me. Code builds for me. I am still. I am green on the globe. I am HERE.
